text: 印尼财政部长Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa周二在雅加达举行的国家预算简报会上表示，印尼计划通过首次发行熊猫债筹集70亿元人民币，约合10亿美元。债券定价预计于7月23日进行，具体仍取决于市场情况。Purbaya表示：“投资者对我们的人民币债券反应积极”。（彭博）
text_en: Indonesian Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa said at a state budget briefing in Jakarta on Tuesday that Indonesia plans to raise 7 billion yuan, about $1 billion, through its first panda bond issuance. Bond pricing is expected on July 23, depending on market conditions. Purbaya said: 'Investors have been positive about our yuan-denominated bonds.' (Bloomberg)
